details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:753-839 (removed_registry_paths 753-769, span extraction 765-767; _covered 771-772; check_diff 803-839; _semantic_errors 616-621 / removals validation) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The deterministic deletion allowlist accepts any backticked path in a removed registry heading, including `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/plan_autopilot.py` and directories such as `tools/runner_scaler/`. It never refuses removal of a "permanent — review annually" entry, and it accepts model-supplied preflight `{check, result}` strings without verifying them.
  WHY: A model steered by untrusted plan, registry or decision text can remove a permanent entry, invent preflight passes and delete the poller workflow or a whole directory, and run_apply pushes that with GH_PAT into an auto-merge maintenance PR. Reviewers disagree on severity: BLOCKER from minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash; MAJOR from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 (filed twice, under SECURITY and IMPLICIT-EXECUTION) and openai_gpt-6-luna; unstated by google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite. The highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:650-653 (cmd_audit `claude_run_selected "$@"`); scripts/ai_engine.sh:782-788, 483-487; scripts/claude_engine.py:578; scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:307-308 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: PLAN_AUDIT is configured with `"profile": "write"`, but claude_run_selected forces AI_ENGINE_READ_ONLY=true, which narrows it to read-only. The read-only snapshot copies tracked files only, so the model cannot see the untracked `.plan-autopilot/audit_input.json`.
  WHY: On the default Claude engine the model cannot edit plans. Any reported change fails check_diff with result_mismatch, no marker is saved, and the audit of up to 75 minutes re-runs on every tick. Only the codex fallback works. BLOCKER from all reviewers that stated a severity; unstated by gemini.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:plan_autopilot job (~2611-2778), step "Resolve Claude credential" (claude-pool-token) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The plan_autopilot job uses claude-pool-token but has no `permissions: id-token: write`.
  WHY: The OIDC token request fails with `oidc_unavailable`, and every audit silently falls back to codex, so the Claude-engine decision (Q9) is never honoured. MAJOR from all reviewers that stated a severity.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:857-895 (build_pr_body; `_one_line(item['stale'], 400)` / `_one_line(item['changed'], 400)` at 860-862; removal titles at 875) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Plan-derived and model-written text reaches the maintenance PR body without the AUTO_CLOSE_RE.sub filter that compose_description applies.
  WHY: A "Fixes/Closes #N" against a tracking issue makes run_lint raise pr_body_lint, which blocks the PR and repeats every tick with no marker. Against an ordinary issue the linter allows it, and GitHub closes that issue on merge (openai_gpt-6-luna). Severity disagreement: NIT (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5) vs MAJOR (minimax, luna, glm); the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:938 (run_apply changelog name; cmd_apply 984 `_now().strftime("%Y%m%d")`; cmd_collect 485) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The expected changelog fragment name uses the apply-time UTC date, while the model was given the collect-time `today`.
  WHY: An audit that crosses 00:00 UTC makes check_diff raise diff_outside_allowlist, and the whole run is wasted. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, luna, glm) vs MAJOR (minimax); the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:383-398 (run_gate `oldest = maintenance[0]`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The open-pulls listing is newest-first, so `maintenance[0]` is the newest maintenance PR, not the oldest.
  WHY: With more than one `ai/plan-autopilot-*` PR open, a stale older PR is never flagged, and the wrong PR number can be reported. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, glm) vs MAJOR (minimax); the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:355-1185 (run_gate snapshot 355-402; run_collect `"open_tracking": []` ~449-485; run_apply 916-960; run_dispatch 1117-1185); .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:112-113, 2632-2636 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Tracking-issue and wrapper-run state is a single snapshot taken before an audit of up to 75 minutes. Collect hardcodes open_tracking to an empty list, and neither apply nor dispatch re-checks.
  WHY: A project that starts during the audit can have its plan edited (the in-flight guard uses stale gate data), and dispatch can start a second, overlapping project. MAJOR from all reviewers that stated a severity.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1246-1306 (render_report 1246-1280; run_report PATCH 1292-1295; cmd_gate fresh state) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A gate skip (maintenance_pr_open, project_open, dispatch_pending) replaces the status-issue body with a skip-only report and drops the prior audit's classification, refreshes and summary. A stale-PR flag raised before any status issue exists is dropped entirely.
  WHY: The first tick after a maintenance PR opens erases the report that Goal 8 says the status issue must show. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, luna) vs MAJOR (glm); the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:345-349, 1294-1300 (run_gate no_plans branch returns before status-issue lookup; run_report create only when `audit_ran or outcome == "error"`) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: A no_plans skip never creates or updates the `ai:plan-autopilot` status issue.
  WHY: A repo with no plans gets no status issue, or keeps a stale report, which breaks Goal 8 and Goal 10. MAJOR (minimax); sonnet raised it inside its NIT skip-report finding; the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1292-1306 (run_report ReadError catch); .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2768-2778 ("Save plan autopilot marker") | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A failed status-issue create or PATCH is caught and logged, but save_marker stays true.
  WHY: A transient GitHub write failure leaves the report unpublished while the marker suppresses a retry for that SHA and UTC day. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (minimax) vs NIT (luna); the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:803-807 (check_diff archive branch; also 830-831; run_apply 934-940) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A plan deletion counts as an archive whenever the `docs/completed/<name>.md` target is in completed_exists, which is built from the working tree. Nothing checks the target's content against the source or confirms the target changed in this diff.
  WHY: The plan content is lost when a stale completed copy already exists, and arbitrary content can be smuggled in under `docs/completed/`. MAJOR from all three reviewers.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:583-594, 119-125 (cache key `plan-autopilot-v1-${PLAN_AUTOPILOT_SHA}-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)`; plan_autopilot_due/plan_autopilot_key outputs) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The marker key contains only the SHA and the UTC day, so a cache hit skips the job regardless of `ai:plan-decision` activity.
  WHY: A trusted answer posted after the day's audit is not read until the next commit or UTC day, which breaks Goal 10's "resumes ... when a decision is answered". MAJOR from both reviewers.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1140-1255 (run_dispatch engine fallback and 10-minute label loop 1163-1180; next_state writes engine_label_pending 1240-1255) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: engine_label_pending is persisted, but no later run reads it, and the project_open gate refuses every later tick.
  WHY: A tracking issue that opens after the 10-minute loop is never labelled `ai:engine-claude`, so the project runs on codex with no automated recovery. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (minimax) vs NIT (glm); the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:plan_autopilot job, cache-marker save step (`actions/cache/save`, `continue-on-error: true`, `always()`) | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: If the marker save fails, the marker is lost even though the audit finished.
  WHY: A transient cache-save failure causes redundant re-audits on later ticks. No severity stated.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1023-1062, 459-470 (run_decisions; trusted_answers) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Trusted author answers pass verbatim into decision_answers and refreshed plan text without AUTO_CLOSE_RE.sub.
  WHY: A member comment such as "Closes #9999" flows into the PR body, which fails pr_body_lint (no PR, no marker) or would auto-close the wrong issue if the lint were absent. MAJOR.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1049-1058 (run_decisions) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A decision issue is closed on the model's applied_decisions output without checking for a collected trusted answer or validating the issue number.
  WHY: A result can claim a decision was applied with no OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR answer, and the script then posts a completion comment and closes the issue. MAJOR.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:605-632, 1117-1131 (_semantic_errors; run_dispatch) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Validation does not reject a plan listed in both needs_decision and recommendation.plans.
  WHY: run_dispatch then starts a project for a plan that still needs an unanswered decision. MAJOR.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:~360-410, 1143-1185 (run_gate dispatch_pending branch; run_dispatch) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The dispatch_pending check looks only at wrapper workflow run statuses and never consults the `dispatched_run` state marker.
  WHY: Two ticks can both see no listed run during the first minutes and both dispatch, starting two projects for the same plan. MAJOR.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:~552-555 (render_state_marker; STATE_MARKER_RE) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: render_state_marker escapes `--` but not `<!--`, and the non-greedy STATE_MARKER_RE can match at the wrong boundary.
  WHY: A payload containing an HTML comment corrupts prior_state and silently drops dispatched_run, engine_label_pending and decision history. MAJOR.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:~660-670 (_git_head) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: _git_head calls subprocess.run directly instead of `_git`, so the SECRET_ENV filter is not applied.
  WHY: The child process inherits GH_TOKEN, GH_PAT and GITHUB_TOKEN; this is a hygiene gap, not
